description.narrative: (Ethiopia): The USAID Health Workforce Improvement Program (HWIP) improves the quality of education and training for health professionals by focusing on strengthening human resource capacity. HWIP partners with 29 higher education institutions to strengthen the capacity of their faculty to design and teach courses, including digital courses. HWIP supports the expansion of gender-sensitive programs with the goal of increasing the number of women in teaching and leadership roles in these institutions and to promote more women professionals in the health sector overall...HWIP works closely with professional associations to promote continuous quality improvement and accreditation of the academic programs and universities...HWIP provides technical and financial support to 200 primary and secondary health facilities to improve evidence-based human resource planning, recruitment and placement, in-service training, continuing professional development, and improved motivation, retention, and performance of the health workforce... .
